Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. The second half of the effect still occurs even if you don’t have a Digimon card to return from your trash.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card if I don't have any Digimon cards in my trash?

Effect: [Main] Return 1 purple Digimon card from your trash to your hand. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (Trash this card in your battle area to activate the effect below. You can't activate this effect the turn this card enters play.)
Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in its owner's battle area.
